create_example_serializer: create an ExampleSerializer instance with TensorInfo specs to serialize nested dict examples
build_tf_example: build a tf.train.Example proto from a flattened dict and TensorInfo mapping
serialize_example: serialize a nested dict example into a serialized tf.train.Example proto string
convert_item_to_tf_feature: convert a single data item to a tf.train.Feature proto based on TensorInfo dtype
extract_ragged_fields: extract flat values and row lengths from nested ragged sequence data
